description: This file contains step definitions for Cucumber tests related to login functionalities in an OrangeHRM web application. It manages scenarios such as login, logout, validation errors, redirections, and security checks, using Selenium WebDriver for browser interactions.

classes.name: LoginSteps
classes.description: Contains step definitions for login-related test scenarios, facilitating interactions with the web application through Selenium WebDriver, and integrating with Cucumber for BDD testing.

methods.name: theOrangeHRMApplicationIsAccessible
methods.description: Verifies the application URL is accessible, logs the attempt, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: theDatabaseIsInAKnownCleanState
methods.description: Assumes database is in a clean state, typically managed externally.

methods.name: theUserIsOnTheLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to specified login page path.

methods.name: theAdminUserIsLoggedIn
methods.description: Performs login as admin user and waits for dashboard URL.

methods.name: anESSUserIsLoggedIn
methods.description: Performs login as ESS user and waits for dashboard URL.

methods.name: aUserAccountExistsThatHasBeenDisabled
methods.description: Precondition step indicating disabled user account exists.

methods.name: anEmployeeHasBeenTerminatedButTheUserAccountStillExists
methods.description: Precondition step indicating a terminated employee with an active user account exists.

methods.name: theUserIsOnThePage
methods.description: Navigates to a specific page and waits for load.

methods.name: noUserIsLoggedIn
methods.description: Clears cookies to ensure no user session is active.

methods.name: theUserEntersUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Inputs provided username and password into login form fields.

methods.name: theUserClicksTheButton
methods.description: Clicks a button with specified text.

methods.name: theUserClicksTheButtonWithoutEnteringCredentials
methods.description: Clicks a button without filling credentials.

methods.name: theUserEntersValidCredentialsAndSubmitsTheForm
methods.description: Logs in with valid admin credentials and submits.

methods.name: theDisabledUserAttemptsToLogInWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Attempts login as a disabled user.

methods.name: theTerminatedEmployeeAttemptsToLogIn
methods.description: Attempts login as a terminated employee.

methods.name: theSessionTimesOut
methods.description: Emulates session timeout by deleting cookies.

methods.name: theUserIsRedirectedToTheLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to login URL to simulate redirect.

methods.name: theUserLogsInAgainWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Re-authenticates with valid credentials.

methods.name: theUserNavigatesToTheLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to a specified login page.

methods.name: theUserAttemptsToNavigateDirectlyTo
methods.description: Attempts direct navigation to a specific path.

methods.name: theUserShouldBeRedirectedToTheDashboard
methods.description: Verifies redirect to dashboard URL.

methods.name: theFieldShouldDisplayValidationError
methods.description: Checks validation error message on a specific field.

methods.name: theLoginPageShouldDisplayAnErrorMessage
methods.description: Verifies presence of login error alert.

methods.name: theLoginPageShouldDisplayAnErrorMessage
methods.description: Alternate step for error message check.

methods.name: theUserShouldRemainOnTheLoginPage
methods.description: Ensures user is still on login page.

methods.name: thePOSTToShouldReturnARedirectResponse
methods.description: Checks that POST request results in a redirect (via URL verification).

methods.name: theLoginLogoImageShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies visibility of login logo image.

methods.name: theLoginBannerImageShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies visibility of login banner image.

methods.name: theSocialMediaSectionShouldBeDisplayedAsConfigured
methods.description: Checks the presence of social media section.

methods.name: theLoginFormShouldContainAHiddenCSRFTokenField
methods.description: Verifies presence of CSRF token field in login form.

methods.name: theCSRFTokenShouldBeIncludedInThePOSTRequestTo
methods.description: Verifies CSRF token inclusion in form submission.

methods.name: theUserShouldBeRedirectedToTheHomePageViaHomePageService
methods.description: Verifies redirection away from login page.

methods.name: noScriptExecutionShouldOccur
methods.description: Checks that no script alert is triggered, preventing XSS.

methods.name: theUserShouldBeRedirectedBackTo
methods.description: Confirms redirect back to a specified URL/path.

methods.name: theUserLogsInAgainWithUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Re-logs in with provided username and password.

methods.name: performLogin
methods.description: Helper method to perform complete login flow with given credentials.
